candidateReview.name: Deleo Pizza Company, LLC Dba Deleo Bros Pizza
candidateReview.note: Same business as the on-file DeLeo Bros. Pizza; opened August 2025 at 202 Occidental Ave S in Pioneer Square, run by cousins Nathaniel Dahlman and Johnny De Leo as a Minnesota-born New York-style pizzeria.

candidateReview.name: Jet City Pizza
candidateReview.note: Puget Sound pizza-delivery chain founded in Kenmore in 1994 and now sold as a franchise (FranchiseHelp lists roughly $60k to open a unit), with outlets in Bothell, Newcastle, Marysville, Tacoma and Seattle's Wedgwood; a commodity delivery chain rather than a distinctive pizzeria.

candidateReview.name: Lodge Pizza
candidateReview.note: No trace of a pizzeria called Lodge Pizza found at 501 2nd Ave W or anywhere else in Seattle across multiple searches; likely a stale or misrecorded permit entry.

directory.name: Alberona's DaVinci Pizza & Pasta
directory.note: Neighborhood pizza-and-pasta shop on Leary Way NW serving New York-style pies, calzones and halal options, including halal pepperoni.

directory.name: Capitale Pizzeria
directory.note: Modern Neapolitan pizzeria on Broadway from the Limoncello team, serving globally-inspired wood-fired pies in the former Boca Pizzeria space.

directory.name: Desi Pizza Kitchen
directory.note: Queen Anne pizzeria built entirely around Indian-spiced pies such as tandoori paneer and butter chicken alongside classic styles like Hawaiian.
directory.address: 2115 Queen Anne Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109

directory.name: Fremont Pizza
directory.note: Fremont bar-and-slice shop serving classic pizza by the slice with vegan options, draft beer and skeeball.

directory.name: Magnolia Pizza & Pasta
directory.note: Longtime Magnolia neighborhood spot on W Emerson Pl serving pizza, calzones and pasta dishes.

directory.name: Numero Uno Pizza
directory.note: Pioneer Square pizza-by-the-slice counter that also serves Turkish lahmacun and pide, with vegetarian, vegan and halal-friendly options.

directory.name: Olympia Pizza & Spaghetti House II
directory.note: Longtime Wallingford pizzeria with a Greek twist (tzatziki, Greek salad, calzones, gluten-free crust), a neighborhood fixture since the early 1970s.
